title: Usernames are unique regardless of case

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description doesn't announce this change. The diff changes the username validation from exact match to case-insensitive match (ilike), causing PUT /api/me to return 400 when attempting to change to a username that differs only by case from an existing one.
